title: Persist prospect intake and sales follow-up through generic Kanbus operations
description:
As a salesperson, I want contact and demo requests to become prospects so I can own their next follow-up.

Feature: Configured prospect lifecycle
  Scenario: Record marketing intake
    Given a brand-configured contact or demo submission link
    When a valid request is submitted to the narrow intake endpoint
    Then a normal Kanbus issue of configured type prospect is persisted through Virtuus
    And source, contact, owner and next follow-up survive a backend reload
    And the public response reveals no CRM record data
  Scenario: Progress a prospect
    Given an authenticated salesperson and a qualified prospect
    When the salesperson advances an allowed configured funnel stage
    Then the persisted issue and shared board show the new stage after reload
    And disallowed transitions are rejected without changing the issue
  Scenario: Find due follow-up
    Given prospect and other issue types with owners and configured follow-up values
    When the app submits ordinary type, assignee and custom-field predicates
    Then it displays only the matching prospects in the shared filtered list
